result.summary: The page is mostly well-formed. The main visual defect is the promo banner, whose white text on a pale mint background is nearly unreadable. The first 'Fastest near you' card also has a minor layout inconsistency.

issues.description: The promo banner headline '3 free deliveries for you' and the subtext 'Use code TALLINN3 at checkout · min. order €10' are white on a very light mint background. The contrast is extremely low and the promo code is almost invisible.
issues.suggestion: Use dark or deep green text on the light banner, or give the banner a darker background. Aim for at least 4.5:1 contrast for body text and 3:1 for large text.

issues.description: In the first 'Fastest near you' card (Green Bowl Poké), the '15–25 min' pill overlaps the plate image and is offset differently from the pills on the other cards. The light, washed-out card background also blends into the page, so the card edge is weak.
issues.suggestion: Position the time badges consistently across cards. Use a darker or more consistent image background, or add a border or shadow so the card edge is clear.

issues.description: The favorite heart icons sit on semi-transparent dark circles that are barely visible against the dark food images. The circle is also inconsistent between the ramen card and the pizza card.
issues.suggestion: Use a consistent, higher-contrast circular backing for the heart icon, such as a white or solid translucent background.
